items.q: Do you repair laptops?
items.a: Yes. We repair laptops and MacBooks of all major brands, including screen replacement, RAM and SSD upgrades, battery, keyboard and trackpad replacement, power jack and charging port repair, liquid spill cleanup, overheating and fan cleaning, data recovery and OS reinstall. See residential services.

items.q: Do you repair Macs and MacBooks?
items.a: Yes. We service both Windows and Apple computers, including iMac, Mac and MacBook repair, along with all major PC and laptop brands.

items.q: Can you remove viruses, spyware and pop-ups?
items.a: If you think you have a virus, turn the computer off right away and bring it in so it doesn't spread to your network. We remove viruses, spyware and malware, clean up what they changed and help you stay protected afterwards.

items.q: Can you recover data from a failed hard drive?
items.a: Often, yes. We recover pictures, documents and other files from PC and laptop hard drives, including files deleted by accident, and copy them to a new drive or USB drive. We test the drive first so you know what can be saved.

items.q: Can you move my files to a new computer?
items.a: Yes. We transfer your pictures, music, documents, email and other files from your old computer to your new one, and can set up the new machine so it is ready to use.

items.q: Can you upgrade my computer instead of replacing it?
items.a: Often, yes. A new SSD, more memory or a new power supply can make an older computer feel new again. We test it first and tell you honestly whether an upgrade or a replacement makes more sense.

items.q: Do you build custom or gaming PCs?
items.a: Yes. We source the parts, build your custom or gaming PC and test it before you pick it up. Call 905-5PC-WERX (905-572-9379) to talk through what you need.

items.q: How long does a computer repair take?
items.a: Most repairs are usually done in 24 to 48 hours. If parts need to be ordered, we’ll tell you the expected timing after we look at it. To check on a repair, call 905-5PC-WERX (905-572-9379).
